_readme: Descriptions and inclusions written from the actual product photograph,
overriding the values inferred from the product name in describe.mjs.
These are observations of the image — specific to what is really in the
setup, not guessed from a title. Add an entry per slug as photos arrive.

lavish-pink-wedding-decor.description: A full-width sheer drape backdrop lit from below in deep pink, with a horseshoe floral arch at the centre framing the couple's seating. Roses run in graded pinks — blush through to deep rose — with green foliage threaded between, and the same flowers repeat along a dense valance across the top of the drape. Fairy lights sit behind the fabric so the whole wall glows rather than being spot-lit. Built for a reception stage in a banquet hall; the arch reads clearly in photographs from across the room.
inclusions: Full-width sheer drape backdrop, gathered, with fairy lights behind the fabric
Central horseshoe floral arch in graded pink and blush roses with foliage
Dense floral valance running the full width along the top of the drape
Four tall floral pedestal arrangements, two either side of the arch
Two ornate high-back throne chairs in white and silver
Pink uplighting washing the drape from the stage floor
Stage carpeting and front skirting
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

classic-white-wedding-backdrop.description: A white sheer drape wall with a dense floral panel at the centre, worked in white and lilac blooms. Eight circular ring lamps hang in a row across the top, each dressed with small white flowers, and the drapes either side are washed from behind in magenta so the fabric glows rather than sitting flat. A carved wooden two-seater sits centre stage, flanked by white pedestals holding tall lily arrangements. The stage front is banked the full width in white daisies, yellow and lilac.
inclusions: Full-width white sheer drape backdrop
Central floral wall panel in white and lilac blooms
Eight hanging circular ring lamps dressed with white flowers
Magenta uplighting behind the drapes on both sides
Two white pedestals with tall white lily arrangements
Carved wooden two-seater in cream upholstery
Full-width floral bank along the stage front in daisies, yellow and lilac
White stage flooring
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

dazzling-greece-arch-decor.description: A pale blue and white setting built from open metal frames rather than a solid backdrop — square gate frames and two tall arched panels, with a crystal chandelier hung in the central arch. Soft blue hydrangea and white roses climb the frames with trailing greenery, and white sheer curtains fall behind so light passes through the whole structure. A curved modern chaise in white sits at the centre, with candle holders and a low floral cluster on the floor.
inclusions: Open metal gate frames and two tall arched panels
Crystal chandelier suspended in the central arch
Soft blue hydrangea and white rose work with trailing greenery
White sheer curtain backing behind the frames
Curved modern chaise in white
Floor candle holders and a low floral cluster
White stage flooring
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

dazzling-white-panel-decor.description: Six white panel boards angled outward like opened doors, each edged in gold, with a patterned centre panel carrying a gold monogram. Gold rings hang either side of the centre holding small yellow floral clusters, and tall floral columns in pink, red and white roses close off both ends. The seating is an ornate gold-framed settee in deep red velvet, set on red carpet, with uplights at the base of every panel throwing the boards into relief.
inclusions: Six gold-edged white panel boards, angled open
Patterned centre panel with a personalised gold monogram
Suspended gold rings with yellow floral clusters
Two tall floral columns in pink, red and white roses
Ornate gold-framed settee in deep red velvet
Uplighting at the base of each panel
Red stage carpeting
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

delightful-white-wedding-decor.description: A white sheer drape backed by a row of slim gold poles, with pendant bulbs hanging between them at staggered heights. The top of the wall carries a deep floral valance in cream, blush and peach roses cut through with palm and fern, and a round monogram sign sits at the centre. A dark-wood chaise in cream upholstery faces out, with tall floral arrangements on gold stands either side and live greenery banked along the stage front.
inclusions: White sheer drape backdrop
Row of slim gold poles across the full width
Pendant bulb lighting hung at staggered heights
Deep floral valance in cream, blush and peach roses with palm and fern
Round personalised monogram sign
Dark-wood chaise in cream upholstery
Tall floral arrangements on gold stands
Live greenery banked along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

duel-white-arch-wedding-decor.description: A pared-back white setting: a squared white frame standing free against a drape, with green foliage garlands laid over its top corners so the structure stays visible. Tall white floral arrangements stand either side on slim stems, hung with crystal strands that catch the light. A curved modern sofa in white sits centre, with soft white fabric pooled at its base and a small white side table alongside. Restrained, and built for a room where the decor should not compete.
inclusions: Free-standing squared white frame
Green foliage garlands laid over the frame corners
Two tall white floral arrangements on slim stems
Hanging crystal strand detailing
Curved modern sofa in white
Soft white fabric pooling at the base
White side table
White draped stage
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

elegant-peach-wedding-decor.description: Peach drapery layered behind a run of rectangular frames, every frame wrapped edge to edge in blush and white florals so the whole structure reads as a flower wall with openings cut through it. The centre opens into an arch with a chandelier hung inside. An ornate cream and gold settee with pink cushions sits on a gold stage floor, with a tall dried arrangement to one side.
inclusions: Layered peach drapery backdrop
Run of rectangular frames wrapped in blush and white florals
Central arched opening with a hanging chandelier
Ornate cream and gold settee with pink cushions
Tall dried floral arrangement
Gold stage flooring
Uplighting along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

elegant-white-panel-wedding-decor.description: Gold-framed panels open outward around a central floral wall in pink and white blooms, with a gold monogram set into the flowers. Two tall gold-framed floral panels stand either side, and lanterns and floral arrangements on gold stands fill the space between. The seating is a carved cream and gold settee. A rose garland in pink and white runs the full width of the stage front against white flooring.
inclusions: Gold-framed panels angled open around the centre
Central floral wall in pink and white blooms
Personalised gold monogram set into the flower wall
Two tall gold-framed floral side panels
Floral arrangements on gold stands, with lanterns
Carved cream and gold settee
Full-width rose garland along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

graceful-peach-wedding-decor.description: A traditional treatment: red patterned panels across the top, peach drapes falling below with hanging strands threaded through, and a heavy floral valance in red, white and pink running the full width. Floral clusters weight the corners. Three peach upholstered benches sit across the stage with a carved centre settee, all on red carpet. Built for a larger family group rather than a couple alone.
inclusions: Red patterned panels across the upper backdrop
Peach drapery with hanging strand detailing
Full-width floral valance in red, white and pink
Corner floral clusters
Carved centre settee with three peach upholstered benches
Red stage carpeting
Warm uplighting through the drape
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

grand-white-and-gold-panel-decor.description: Seven marble-effect boards in gold frames, fanned outward and edged with LED strip so each panel outlines itself against a dark room. A rose garland swags across the centre board in red, white and green. The seating is a gold settee in white upholstery. The stage front is banked in red and white roses with greenery, and the dark backdrop makes the lit frames the whole of the picture.
inclusions: Seven marble-effect boards in gold frames, fanned outward
LED strip edging on each panel
Rose garland swag across the centre board in red, white and green
Gold settee in white upholstery
Floral columns at both ends
Red and white rose bank along the stage front with greenery
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

lavish-white-and-yellow-decor.description: A white drape washed in warm yellow, with white floral garlands hanging from above and chandeliers dropped in front of the fabric. Gold ring frames stand either side wrapped in greenery and white blooms, and a carved wooden settee in cream sits at the centre. Greenery runs along the stage front. The whole setting is lit warm rather than white, which is what gives it the gold cast.
inclusions: White drape backdrop under warm yellow wash
White floral garlands hung from above
Chandeliers dropped in front of the drape
Gold ring frames wrapped in greenery and white blooms
Carved wooden settee in cream upholstery
Greenery run along the stage front
Warm uplighting throughout
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

lavish-white-panel-decoration.description: A draped ceiling over marble-effect boards in gold frames, with a greenery and white floral valance across the centre span. Three separate seating pieces are set out rather than one, so a larger party can sit together. Chandeliers hang at intervals, floral arrangements stand between the boards, and dense foliage with white roses runs the length of the stage front. Sized for a banquet hall.
inclusions: Draped ceiling treatment over the stage
Marble-effect boards in gold frames across the full width
Greenery and white floral valance across the centre span
Three separate seating pieces in cream and white
Chandeliers hung at intervals
Floral arrangements set between the boards
Dense foliage and white rose bank along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

lovely-yellow-and-pink-decor.description: Gold drapery either side of a pink and lavender centre panel, with a chandelier hung in front and a gold settee below it. Floral arch frames close both ends in red, white and green, and white pedestals hold matching arrangements. The stage front is banked in mixed purple, white and yellow blooms. Warmer and more colourful than the white settings, and it photographs well under hall lighting.
inclusions: Gold drapery to both sides
Pink and lavender centre drape panel
Chandelier hung in front of the centre panel
Floral arch frames at both ends in red, white and green
White pedestals with matching floral arrangements
Ornate gold settee
Mixed floral bank along the stage front in purple, white and yellow
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

peach-wedding-backdrop-decor.description: Blush and peach drapes hung in panels, topped with a white floral valance that drops trailing strands between wall sconces. Tall vases either side hold white and pink arrangements with feathered stems. An ornate gold and cream settee sits on red carpet, and a mixed floral garland with ferns runs along the stage front. Soft and warm rather than bright.
inclusions: Blush and peach drapery hung in panels
White floral valance with trailing strand detail
Wall sconce lighting set into the drape
Two tall vase arrangements in white and pink with feathered stems
Ornate gold and cream settee
Red stage carpeting
Mixed floral garland with ferns along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

radiant-white-and-gold-decor.description: Gold drapes to both sides hung with vertical light strands, framing a dense white and green flower wall at the centre with pink blooms cascading down it. A band of red and white roses runs along the base of the wall. The seating is a carved white and gold settee with an oval mirrored back. High contrast between the gold sides and the white centre, so the flower wall carries the frame.
inclusions: Gold drapery to both sides with vertical light strands
Dense white and green flower wall at the centre
Cascading pink floral strands down the flower wall
Red and white rose band along the base
Carved white and gold settee with oval mirrored back
White stage flooring
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

red-and-white-hexagon-decor.description: Ivory drapes behind slim gold geometric outlines, with red and white rose clusters set at the joints so the shapes read clearly against the fabric. A deep red swag is drawn through the centre and left to fall. The seating is a gold settee in grey upholstery, with white fabric pooled to one side and floral clusters at the base. The red is used sparingly, which is what keeps it from going heavy.
inclusions: Ivory drape backdrop
Slim gold geometric frame outlines
Red and white rose clusters set at the frame joints
Deep red fabric swag drawn through the centre
Gold settee in grey upholstery
Pooled white fabric detailing
Floral clusters at the stage base
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

stunning-white-wedding-decor.description: Cream drapes threaded with fairy-light strands, with two foliage and white floral arches standing either side of the centre. A carved gold settee with an oval mirrored back sits on white flooring, and a single low floral arrangement is set in front of the stage. Lit warm throughout, so the gold in the frame and the settee carries the colour and the flowers stay white.
inclusions: Cream drape backdrop threaded with fairy-light strands
Two foliage and white floral arches flanking the centre
Carved gold settee with oval mirrored back
Low floral arrangement set in front of the stage
Warm uplighting through the drape
White stage flooring
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

tri-circle-white-wedding-decor.description: Three gold ring frames set against a white drape, each carrying floral garlands in blush, pink and burgundy roses with greenery trailing down through the openings. A curved pink sofa on a gold frame sits at the centre with a gold side table. Tall white floral arrangements stand on gold stands either side, and black and gold lanterns line the stage edge above white steps.
inclusions: Three gold ring frames against a white drape
Floral garlands on each ring in blush, pink and burgundy roses
Trailing greenery through the ring openings
Curved pink sofa on a gold frame
Gold side table
Two tall white floral arrangements on gold stands
Black and gold lanterns lining the stage edge
White stage steps
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

white-bliss-wedding-decor.description: An ivory drape gathered into swagged sections, with three chandeliers hung across the span and a white and green floral valance along the top. A modern curved chaise in white sits at the centre with a tall floral arrangement beside it. Teal accent lighting is thrown behind the fabric, and the stage front is banked in red and white roses with foliage.
inclusions: Ivory drape gathered into swagged sections
Three chandeliers hung across the span
White and green floral valance along the top
Modern curved chaise in white
Tall floral arrangement beside the seating
Teal accent lighting behind the drape
Red and white rose bank along the stage front
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup

western-style-wedding-decor.description: A dark starlit backdrop with a large circular cream disc at the centre carrying a neon script sign. Slim gold arch frames stand behind, strung with light, and pastel floral clusters in peach, lavender and cream run along the base of the whole setting. Champagne skirting fronts the stage above carpeted steps. Modern and low-lit, and it suits an evening reception better than a daytime function.
inclusions: Dark starlit backdrop panel
Large circular cream disc with a personalised neon script sign
Slim gold arch frames strung with lighting
Pastel floral clusters in peach, lavender and cream along the base
Champagne stage skirting
Carpeted stage steps
Delivery, setup, on-site supervision and cleanup
